title: Weekly releases — August 10, 2026
description: Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash models rolling out; Agent Plugins 1.0 now generally available; improved plugin management in app; CLI enhancements with /tasks and queued prompts; JetBrains gets Copilot memory and Ollama support.

community_feedback.quote: Agent Plugins 1.0 is a real plugin system, not just a roadmap promise
Existing GitHub Copilot plugins that don't target Agent Plugins 1.0 continue to work, so you can migrate when it makes sense
Did GitHub's Copilot get a huge upgrade in the last few weeks? It now consistently finds real issues and is genuinely helpful

title: Cross-session messaging and self-hosted environments
description: Claude Code v2.1.220–v2.1.224 (August 3–7, 2026): Cross-session messaging allows sessions to communicate on macOS/Linux; self-hosted environments now in public beta for Team/Enterprise plans; auto mode becomes default starting August 14; VS Code extension gets Focus view.

community_feedback.quote: I built a general version of this, with global addresses and messaging between any terminal-based agent + MCP for browser agents
You simply tell Claude what the other session needs to know, and it writes and sends the message automatically
Claude Code efficiency feels noticeably worse - significantly less efficient/reliable over recent weeks
Testing showed auto mode blocked 80%+ of dangerous queries while humans only caught 14%
The promotion was the only thing making Claude usable
Anthropic's confidence in Claude Code's auto mode is notable
Service disruption on August 16, 2026 affected Claude Code and other services
Sessions can message each other, and Claude sends a summary (not full history or files) when communicating
